description: Áreas de Inundação do Delta do Jacuí - TR 100 is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Planície de inundação do Delta do Jacuí com diferentes tempos de retorno. Modelagem hidrodinâmica do Delta do Jacuí, contendo os polígonos da mancha de inundação para o tempo de retorno de cem anos. Dado oriundo do “Estudos e projeto conceitual de proteção contra cheias do Delta do Jacuí em Eldorado do Sul/RS”. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Offline Data, Mancha de Inundação, Planície de Inundação, Metroplan, Delta do Jacuí. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
